'''Mendel Baudo''' was a reclusive [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] who owned a [[Mendel Baudo Shipyards|shipwright company]] along with small [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] that produced the [[Baudo-class star yacht|''Baudo''-class star yacht]] during the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Known as an eccentric and a perfectionist, Baudo had each yacht custom-built to its owner's specifications, and only accepted orders from customers who had been referred to [[Gender/Legends|him]] by previous customers.<ref name="SotG" />
